ddr_check: ODE TRDR footprints for the 2011-2012 FRTs overstate coverage. Verified by range-downloading DDR bands 4-5 (areocentric lat, lon) and counting which of the 1024 100 m cells of the box contain a CRISM pixel. Control FRT000058A3 = 1.0 (matches its MTRDR). FRT000248E9 = 1.0 (full coverage, no MTRDR, TRDR+DDR only). FRT00021C92 = 0.133, FRT000233AC = 0.103.
